summary: Workspace CI routes all four required gates and their tiny evidence/control jobs to the existing owned priority role for trusted merge-group and protected-main push events. Fourteen Workspace job definitions change placement, avoiding nine of fourteen initial hosted dispatches in the sampled merge run. Every PR retains its existing placement. Main-owned metadata-only Draft CI admission also uses owned capacity without checking out or executing the triggering PR. Required names, validation and permissions are unchanged; no metered capacity is added.

compatibility.detail: Required check names and semantics are unchanged. Every PR, including forks and same-repository heads, retains existing Workspace placement. Genie and TypeScript keep their Nix commands; web receipt validation explicitly provisions Node on owned workers. Draft admission qualifies Python and executes only the main-owned embedded metadata helper with unchanged token scopes.

downtime.detail: New workflow runs use the changed labels; existing runs retain their placement.

manual.detail: Uses the existing owned priority role; no provisioning, subscription or variable change.

recovery.detail: Revert the workflow source and regenerate.
